name: find_sessions
description: The coding sessions you can message on your team's lightbulb network (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok CLI, OpenCode): this computer's, then your teammates'. Pass one's session_id as send_message session_id; is_this_session marks your own: never message it.

query.description: Text to find (case-insensitive) in a session's id, agent, folder, repo, branch, title, task, person or computer. Empty lists all.

name: send_message
description: Sends text to exactly one of: session_id (a coding session from find_sessions, on this computer or a teammate's, sent peer to peer), room_id (a channel or DM from find_rooms) or person_id (a workspace member's id; opens your DM with them if needed). reply_to (the request_id of a message you got from check_inbox) answers that message; reply_to alone replies to whoever sent it. A room or person send may reply in a thread (reply_to_message_id) and mention room members (mention_ids); a session send takes neither. request_id: a new [A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,128} string; reuse it only to retry that same send. Returns its receipt; its note says where the message waits.

request_id.description: A new [A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,128} string; reuse it only to retry this send.

reply_to.description: The request_id of the message this answers.

reply_to_message_id.description: A room send: the id of the message (from read_messages) this replies to in its thread.

mention_ids.description: A room send: the ids of the room members it mentions.

name: message_receipt
description: The receipt of a message you sent, by its request_id, including when the send's answer was lost.

request_id.description: The request_id of a message you sent.

name: check_inbox
description: Takes the messages sent to you on the team's lightbulb network, first waiting up to wait_secs for one; one call may return sooner, so call again to keep waiting. Each message has its raw text and, in framed, the text as delivered; pass its request id as send_message reply_to to answer it.

wait_secs.description: Wait up to this many seconds for a message to arrive.

name: recall
description: Call when a task starts or you need something a teammate may know. The answer also includes excerpts from your own prompts and replies in this repository on this computer.

name: remember
description: Returns what is already known on the subject; call again with `replaces` if yours is a change. Personal unless the person says to share

name: find_rooms
description: Find channels and existing DMs that the signed-in person may read.

name: read_messages
description: Read the latest page or continue after a message sequence in a room or DM.

name: find_tasks
description: Find tasks on this workspace's task board. Open tasks (backlog, todo, in_progress, in_review, blocked) unless status names others (comma-separated; also done, cancelled). assignee is an agent name. Newest-updated first.

name: read_task
description: Read one task by identifier (e.g. ISOA-123) or id: title, status, priority, assignee, full description, blockers, and its latest comments.

name: update_task
description: Change a task's status (backlog, todo, in_progress, in_review, blocked, done, cancelled) or priority (critical, high, medium, low), and/or append a dated note to the end of its description. This tool posts no comment: a task comment wakes the assigned agent and starts a paid run, so it is not offered here.

name: use_browser
description: Choose where this shared Claude Code or Codex session browses with its lightbulb-browser tools: "mac" (its Mac's Lightbulb agent Chrome, the default) or "cloud" (the workspace's cloud browser). Its next browser connection goes there; one already open stays where it is: to move an open one now, restart the lightbulb-browser MCP server (/mcp in Claude Code).
